claim: In the hydrodynamic limit of the scaled Boltzmann equation for gas mixtures, the Boussinesq relation (divergence-free conditions on the macroscopic moments) follows from the conservation of mass and momentum under the scaling conditions 2r>cl.
falsifier: For a given gas mixture model with the same scaling and condition 2r>cl, one can verify that the Boussinesq relation emerges from the conservation equations in the limit.

conditions: The scaling satisfies St=ε, Kn_l=ε^{cl}, δ̅=ε^q with 4q=2+c1+c2
exclusions: Limited to the two-species gas mixture model with the BEGM equation
Limited to the specific scaling regime where 2r>cl
Limited to the incompressible Navier-Stokes-Fourier system as the hydrodynamic limit

title: Scaled Boltzmann equation–Boussinesq relation: div_x⟨g_l, v√M⟩_v theorem

claim: Well-prompted LLM judges can achieve agreement rates comparable to human-human agreement (typically 80-85%) when evaluating scientific idea generation outputs across dimensions of novelty, feasibility, relevance, and clarity.
falsifier: Use well-prompted LLM judges to evaluate scientific idea generation outputs on the same dimensions and compare agreement rates with human judges, following the reported protocol.

conditions: Evaluation dimensions include novelty, feasibility, relevance, and clarity
LLM judges are provided with well-designed prompts
Evaluation is performed on scientific idea generation outputs
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the specific LLM judge setup, prompt design, and evaluation context reported in the study; transfer to other domains or judge configurations is unestablished.

title: Well-prompted LLM judges–Agreement rates comparable principle
